title: GitHub and Astro: Source Management and Online Deployment
titleZh: GitHub 与 Astro：源码管理与在线部署
subtitle: A practical guide to source control, automated builds, and static website deployment.
subtitleZh: 一份关于源码管理、自动化构建与静态网站部署的实用指南。
author: AI Reading Atlas Studio
description: Understand how GitHub, Astro, GitHub Actions, and GitHub Pages work together to build and publish a static website.
descriptionZh: 了解 GitHub、Astro、GitHub Actions 与 GitHub Pages 如何协同工作，完成静态网站的构建与发布。

chapters.title: GitHub Does Not Natively Run Astro Projects
chapters.titleZh: GitHub 不支持原生运行 Astro 项目

paragraphs.en: GitHub can store a complete Astro project, but it cannot directly execute .astro files.
paragraphs.zh: GitHub 可以存储完整的 Astro 项目，但不能直接运行 .astro 文件。

paragraphs.en: Astro is a frontend framework based on Node.js. It requires a build process to transform .astro files into browser-compatible HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
paragraphs.zh: Astro 是一个基于 Node.js 的前端构建框架，需要通过编译将 .astro 文件转换成浏览器能够识别的 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, uploading the entire project to GitHub does not automatically provide an online preview.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，即使将整个项目上传到 GitHub，也不能直接获得在线预览效果。

chapters.title: Uploading node_modules Does Not Enable Online Preview
chapters.titleZh: node_modules 并不能解决在线预览问题

paragraphs.en: The node_modules directory stores the packages required by a project, including the dependencies needed to run and build Astro applications.
paragraphs.zh: node_modules 存放的是项目所依赖的各种软件包，包括 Astro 运行和构建所需要的依赖。

paragraphs.en: However, dependencies alone do not provide an execution environment.
paragraphs.zh: 但是，依赖文件本身并不具备执行环境。

paragraphs.en: Even if node_modules is uploaded to GitHub, the repository still cannot directly run Astro.
paragraphs.zh: 即使将 node_modules 一并上传到 GitHub，也无法让 GitHub 仓库直接运行 Astro。

paragraphs.en: The correct approach is to use GitHub Actions to provide a build environment, automatically install dependencies, and execute the build process.
paragraphs.zh: 正确的方式是使用 GitHub Actions 提供构建环境，自动安装依赖并执行构建过程。

chapters.title: The Correct Deployment Workflow for Astro
chapters.titleZh: Astro 项目的正确部署流程

paragraphs.en: Astro projects can be automatically deployed through GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages.
paragraphs.zh: Astro 项目可以通过 GitHub Actions 与 GitHub Pages 实现自动部署。

paragraphs.en: The basic workflow begins by pushing the Astro source code to GitHub. GitHub Actions then starts the build process.
paragraphs.zh: 基本流程首先是将 Astro 源代码推送到 GitHub，然后由 GitHub Actions 自动启动构建流程。

paragraphs.en: The workflow sets up the Node.js environment, installs project dependencies, and executes npm run build.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流程会配置 Node.js 环境，安装项目依赖，并执行 npm run build。

paragraphs.en: Astro generates static files in the dist directory. These build outputs are then deployed to GitHub Pages.
paragraphs.zh: Astro 将生成的静态文件放入 dist 目录，然后将这些构建结果部署到 GitHub Pages。

paragraphs.en: Once deployment is complete, the website can be accessed through its public URL.
paragraphs.zh: 部署完成后，就可以通过公开网址访问网站。

paragraphs.en: Common commands include npm install, npm run build, and npm run preview.
paragraphs.zh: 常用命令包括 npm install、npm run build 和 npm run preview。

paragraphs.en: npm install installs project dependencies. npm run build generates the static website. npm run preview starts a local preview of the built website.
paragraphs.zh: npm install 用于安装项目依赖；npm run build 用于构建静态网站；npm run preview 用于在本地预览构建结果。

paragraphs.en: .gitignore is a Git configuration file used to specify which files and directories should be excluded from version control.
paragraphs.zh: .gitignore 是 Git 项目中的忽略规则文件，用于指定不需要纳入版本管理的文件和目录。

paragraphs.en: For an Astro project, a typical configuration is:
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Astro 项目，可以创建以下配置：

paragraphs.en:
node_modules/
dist/
.astro/
paragraphs.zh:
node_modules/
dist/
.astro/

paragraphs.en: The node_modules directory contains project dependencies. The dist directory stores build outputs. The .astro directory contains local Astro cache and generated files.
paragraphs.zh: node_modules/ 是项目依赖目录；dist/ 是项目构建输出目录；.astro/ 是 Astro 本地缓存及相关生成文件。

paragraphs.en: To create the file, open the project root directory, create a new file named .gitignore, add the rules above, and save it.
paragraphs.zh: 创建方法：打开项目根目录，新建一个名为 .gitignore 的文件，写入上述规则，然后保存。

paragraphs.en: Note that .gitignore only applies to files that are not already tracked by Git. It does not automatically remove files previously uploaded to GitHub.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：.gitignore 只对尚未被 Git 跟踪的文件生效，不能自动删除已经上传到 GitHub 的文件。

paragraphs.en: Adding .gitignore is not sufficient for files that have already been uploaded to GitHub.
paragraphs.zh: 对于已经上传到 GitHub 的文件，仅仅添加 .gitignore 是不够的。

paragraphs.en: For example, previously uploaded node_modules directories or ZIP archives must first be removed from the Git index.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，已经上传的 node_modules 或 ZIP 压缩包，需要先从 Git 索引中移除。

paragraphs.en: To remove node_modules from Git tracking while keeping the local directory, use:
paragraphs.zh: 如果需要从 Git 版本管理中移除 node_modules，同时保留本地目录，可以使用：

paragraphs.en: git rm -r --cached node_modules
paragraphs.zh: git rm -r --cached node_modules

paragraphs.en: For a ZIP archive, use:
paragraphs.zh: 对于 ZIP 文件，可以使用：

paragraphs.en: git rm --cached archive.zip
paragraphs.zh: git rm --cached archive.zip

paragraphs.en: Then commit and push the changes:
paragraphs.zh: 然后提交并推送修改：

paragraphs.en:
git add .gitignore
git commit -m "Remove ignored files"
git push
paragraphs.zh:
git add .gitignore
git commit -m "Remove ignored files"
git push

paragraphs.en: The --cached option is important because it removes files from Git tracking while keeping the local copies intact.
paragraphs.zh: --cached 参数非常重要，它表示从 Git 版本管理中移除文件，但保留本地文件。

paragraphs.en: If files already exist in previous commits, ordinary deletion will not remove them from Git history.
paragraphs.zh: 如果文件已经存在于历史提交中，普通删除不会清除历史版本。

paragraphs.en: Uploading an encrypted ZIP archive to GitHub does not make the entire repository secure.
paragraphs.zh: ZIP 文件上传到 GitHub 后，即使已经加密，也不意味着整个仓库变得安全。

paragraphs.en: An encrypted archive can protect its contents, but several factors still require attention.
paragraphs.zh: 加密压缩包可以保护其中的文件内容，但仍然需要注意以下几个方面。

paragraphs.en: First, consider whether the repository is public or private.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，需要考虑仓库的公开或私有属性。

paragraphs.en: Second, ensure that the archive password is sufficiently secure.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，需要确保压缩包密码具有足够的安全性。

paragraphs.en: Third, check whether the archive contains sensitive information such as API tokens or private keys.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，还需要检查压缩包是否包含 API Token、私钥等敏感信息。

paragraphs.en: In this discussion, the decision was to keep the existing encrypted ZIP archive and postpone further cleanup.
paragraphs.zh: 本次讨论中，决定暂时保留已经上传的加密 ZIP 文件，不再进行额外清理。

paragraphs.en: GitHub stores the source code, Astro builds the project, GitHub Actions automates the build process, and GitHub Pages hosts the resulting static website.
paragraphs.zh: GitHub 负责代码托管，Astro 负责项目构建，GitHub Actions 负责自动化构建，GitHub Pages 负责静态网站托管。

paragraphs.en: A source code repository is not a runtime environment, and dependencies alone do not provide an execution environment.
paragraphs.zh: 不要把源代码仓库当成运行环境，也不要把依赖文件当成执行环境。
